en.text: Sing aloud to God, our strength! a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!

zhSimplified.text: 你们当向 神—我们的力量大声欢呼， 的 神发声欢乐！

zhTraditional.text: 你們當向上帝－我們的力量大聲歡呼， 的上帝發聲歡樂！

en.text: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.
Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.
For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

zhSimplified.text: 因这是为定的律例， 神的典章。

zhTraditional.text: 因這是為定的律例， 上帝的典章。

en.text: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.

zhSimplified.text: 他去攻击地的时候， 中间立此为证。 听见我所不明白的言语：

zhTraditional.text: 他去攻擊地的時候， 中間立此為證。 聽見我所不明白的言語：

en.text: “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.
You called in trouble, and I delivered you. you in the secret place of thunder. you at the waters of Meribah.”

zhSimplified.text: 你在急难中呼求，我就搭救你； 水那里试验你。

zhTraditional.text: 你在急難中呼求，我就搭救你； 水那裏試驗你。

en.text: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, you would listen to me!

zhSimplified.text: 我的民哪，你当听，我要劝戒你； 啊，甚愿你肯听从我。

zhTraditional.text: 我的民哪，你當聽，我要勸戒你； 啊，甚願你肯聽從我。

en.text: There shall be no strange god in you, shall you worship any foreign god.

zhSimplified.text: 在你当中，不可有别的神；

zhTraditional.text: 在你當中，不可有別的神；

en.text: I am the LORD, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

zhSimplified.text: 我是耶和华—你的 神， 地领上来；

zhTraditional.text: 我是耶和華－你的上帝， 地領上來；

en.text: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. of me.

zhSimplified.text: 无奈，我的民不听我的声音； 全不理我。

zhTraditional.text: 無奈，我的民不聽我的聲音； 全不理我。

en.text: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.

zhSimplified.text: 我便任凭他们心里刚硬，

zhTraditional.text: 我便任憑他們心裏剛硬，

en.text: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!

zhSimplified.text: 甚愿我的民肯听从我， 肯行我的道，

zhTraditional.text: 甚願我的民肯聽從我， 肯行我的道，

en.text: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.

zhSimplified.text: 我便速速治服他们的仇敌，

zhTraditional.text: 我便速速治服他們的仇敵，

en.text: The haters of the LORD would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.

zhSimplified.text: 恨耶和华的人必来投降，

zhTraditional.text: 恨耶和華的人必來投降，

en.text: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”

zhSimplified.text: 他也必拿上好的麦子给他们吃，

zhTraditional.text: 他也必拿上好的麥子給他們吃，
